title: A Stretchable Nanowire UV-Vis-NIR Photodetector with High Performance

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Wearable optoelectronics need a photodetector that covers UV to NIR and keeps working under large stretching. A PbS QD-P3HT hybrid nanowire written as a free-standing arch should sense UV to NIR and tolerate stretching.
states.detail: Absorbed: a1 (HYP/need), a2 (HYP/hypothesis), a3 (DES/base_system), a4 (DES/modification), a5 (DES/architecture), a6 (DES/route), a7 (DES/variable_sweep), a8 (PRC/synthesis), a9 (PRC/forming). Premises: PbS quantum dots act as NIR sensitisers in hybrid polymer photodetectors

states.title: Structure state
states.head: PbS QDs are dispersed through the body of the written P3HT nanowire. The written wire stands as a free arch spanning the electrode gap rather than lying on the substrate

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The ON/OFF ratio rises with QD loading and falls with QD size, peaking at 60 wt% of 4.4 nm QDs. The hybrid wire responds from 365 to 940 nm, whereas the NIR response is absent without QDs.
states.detail: Absorbed: a12 (PRP/value), a13 (PRP/value), a14 (MEC/pathway), a15 (PRP/value), a17 (MEC/pathway). Premises: Photoinduced charge transfer between P3HT and PbS quantum dots quenches the QD photoluminescence; A larger PbS dot gives an unfavourable band offset that restricts hole transfer to P3HT; An arched free-standing wire accommodates substrate strain by geometric relaxation

states.title: Performance state
states.head: The 3x3 array holds its ON/OFF ratio and response time through stretching to 100% and 100 stretch cycles

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Directly written PbS QD-P3HT nanowire arches give a stretchable UV-vis-NIR photodetector array with high and stable ON/OFF ratios

nodes.title: evidence, F2, F3
nodes.head: Plateau ON/OFF ratios of ~300 at 365 nm, ~600 at 625 nm and ~15 at 850 nm over six on-off cycles. ON/OFF ratio rises monotonically with QD loading from 0 to 60 wt% at all nine wavelengths.
nodes.solves: The ON/OFF ratio rises with QD loading and falls with QD size, peaking at 60 wt% of 4.4 nm QDs
nodes.op: compare across conditions, read characteristic point, read trend

panel_conditions.condition: the three given wavelengths of 365, 625 and 850 nm
ON/OFF ratios of the hybrid NWPDs for nine wavelengths as a function of concentration

nodes.note: read against each panel's own y axis, which tops out at 600, 1200 and 30 respectively, so the NIR plateau is about 40 times below the visible one log ordinate; the 850 and 940 nm series carry no point at 0 wt%, so pure P3HT gives no measurable NIR response log ordinate; the drop is steepest between 4.4 and 5.5 nm and flattens above 7 nm
nodes.detail: c4: Plateau ON/OFF ratios of ~300 at 365 nm, ~600 at 625 nm and ~15 at 850 nm over six on-off cycles; c6: ON/OFF ratio rises monotonically with QD loading from 0 to 60 wt% at all nine wavelengths; c7: ON/OFF ratio falls monotonically as QD size goes from 4.4 to 9.1 nm at every wavelength

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: Rise and fall times marked on the expanded traces: 0.16/0.11 s at 365 nm, 0.16/0.12 s at 625 nm and 0.58/0.48 s at 850 nm
nodes.solves: Switching is fast: rise and fall within ~0.16 s in the UV-vis and ~0.5 s in the NIR for a single wire
nodes.note: values are printed on the right-hand panels as TR and TF; each is bracketed between two dash-dot guides, and the NIR pair is quoted as approximate while the other two are upper bounds
nodes.detail: c5: Rise and fall times marked on the expanded traces: 0.16/0.11 s at 365 nm, 0.16/0.12 s at 625 nm and 0.58/0.48 s at 850 nm

nodes.title: evidence, F3
nodes.head: Film absorbance rises with QD loading across 300-800 nm, and a band near 1150 nm appears for every QD-loaded film but not for pure P3HT
nodes.solves: The hybrid wire responds from 365 to 940 nm, whereas the NIR response is absent without QDs

nodes.title: PL, F3
nodes.head: The blend PL band is strongly quenched against the pristine QD band at 4.4 nm and almost unquenched at 5.5 nm
nodes.solves: QDs absorb into the NIR and transfer photogenerated holes to P3HT, a transfer that weakens as the QD grows and the band offset becomes unfavourable
nodes.note: three stacked emission windows on one axis; the solid/dashed gap closes progressively from 4.4 to 5.5 nm, so only three of the five QD sizes are shown
nodes.detail: c9: The blend PL band is strongly quenched against the pristine QD band at 4.4 nm and almost unquenched at 5.5 nm
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown, and S2 keeps shown support from c4, c5, c6, c7.

nodes.title: OPTICAL:photograph, F4
nodes.head: Optical frames of one arch show it flattening from a tall curve at 0% to a shallow one at 100% stretching while staying anchored at both pads
nodes.solves: The arch geometry takes up the external strain by unbending, so the wire material itself is barely strained
nodes.note: the same panel also holds a 5 mm-bar photograph of the flexed 3x3 array in its PDMS sheet; the micrograph series carries a 5 um bar
nodes.detail: c10: Optical frames of one arch show it flattening from a tall curve at 0% to a shallow one at 100% stretching while staying anchored at both pads
nodes.necessity_reason: S2 keeps shown support from c4, c5, c6, c7 after removal.

nodes.title: evidence, F4
nodes.head: The normalised on-off waveform at 365, 625 and 850 nm is unchanged at 0, 50 and 100% stretching and at the 1st, 50th and 100th cycle. Across 0-100% stretching the array's ON/OFF ratio stays flat at ~27 (365 nm), ~50 (625 nm) and ~4 (850 nm) and its rise/fall times stay within 0.3-0.7 s
nodes.solves: The 3x3 array holds its ON/OFF ratio and response time through stretching to 100% and 100 stretch cycles
nodes.note: the 850 nm trace is plotted at x5 in both panels, so its true modulation is five times smaller than it appears; the ordinate is normalised, so absolute levels cannot be compared with Figure 2 read off the log ON/OFF axis and the two linear time axes; the error bars are wide enough to hide a factor of about 1.5
nodes.detail: c11: The normalised on-off waveform at 365, 625 and 850 nm is unchanged at 0, 50 and 100% stretching and at the 1st, 50th and 100th cycle; c12: Across 0-100% stretching the array's ON/OFF ratio stays flat at ~27 (365 nm), ~50 (625 nm) and ~4 (850 nm) and its rise/fall times stay within 0.3-0.7 s
